body:
Current vanilla Consul session/index transactions plus the broker's local pre/post expiry checks cannot enforce strict real-UTC consensus-commit expiry under unconstrained delay. This adds a scoped ADR and an executable MODEL_ONLY counterexample: identical client/native-record observations can correspond to commits before or after expiry. A late reader denial preserves known commit history and cannot undo it.

Only three model/test/document files are added. No runtime module, shared schema, issuer, scheduler or native admission path changes. Option 1 remains strict; logical mutations stay DISABLED. This is a current-component conditional argument, not a universal impossibility theorem or a native consensus test.

Exact HEAD: fb177d14b1e6e399bd9b66ae7cb35d3838acbd81
Tree: 2cba4b0a1ee7621ef213600d6334db8e9ac7dae1
Base: 2f94da511681811588e0f850a0a0e9dc4479c8b8 (existing negative/local reference, not approved HA runtime assembly).

Validation: fresh exact-source Windows CPython3.12.10, seven MODEL_ONLY tests PASS/0skip; 824 tracked raw files matched Git blobs before/after, no extras. Original test-first missing-model setup error retained as 0tests/1error, not seven native REDs. Independent reviewer found no actionable P0/P1/P2; reviewer also reported seven pure model tests PASS. No native RPC, sessions, worker/Job, browser, physical/service/provider calls. Hosted CI/Linux/native/physical acceptance NOT_VERIFIED here.

Pinned upstream evidence: Consul1.22.2 commit71f21bf33d6070fc1522b3ba225b4aac0a390049; seven source files retained/hash-checked against exact commit. No upstream source executed.

External evidence: Agent2 outputs/D4-STRICT-UTC-FB177D1/SHA256.json, SHA256 bbe1fc8c679c7d9261efbddb8550bdb35fe61c6f9aec9762e2240ba37b7262a9. Fresh receipt964cb4e7d1060c17a5c661d956369c8dcca07accb5b61758bcc3c135efa9b893; model traces e2ff9ecfefe2e6ec87a22a03ba231ee6dba4065885868495e3fb14dd21be2e22.

GO/NO-GO: MASTER IN_PROGRESS / NO-GO. No merge/deployment/activation permission. Any stronger time-aware protocol requires a separately versioned operator decision, exact commit event/UTC uncertainty/enforcement proof and native acceptance; no second consensus/election or policy2 fallback.
title: test(authority): demonstrate current strict commit-UTC boundary with executable model
